rows.grounds: pañcabhiḥ + ca fused in one token

items.question: Which five form-lords of Bhagiratha must accompany the gods during worship?
premises: The gods are objects of sequential worship.
The worshipped gods are accompanied by form-lords.
These accompanying form-lords are five and belong to Bhagiratha.
items.inference: The worship of the gods must include accompaniment by Bhagiratha's five form-lords.
uncertainties: The specific identities of the five mūrtīśas are not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Worship all the gods, accompanied by the five form-lords of Bhagiratha.
